**Chinese name:** 盛美半导体设备（上海）股份有限公司 (Shèngměi Bàndǎotǐ Shèbèi (Shànghǎi) Gǔfèn Yǒuxiàn Gōngsī)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China-based subsidiary of NASDAQ-listed ACM Research — its Shanghai and Korea units were both added to the Entity List in the same December 2024 action that named Naura, illustrating how a dual-listed structure doesn't shield the China-based operating unit.
:::

## What does this firm supply?

Wafer cleaning systems, electrochemical plating (ECP) tools, PECVD deposition, furnace, and track platforms — several adjacent front-end process categories beyond its original cleaning-tool business.
